department: Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences (Basic Science Division)

app_fee.value: The Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences charges a $90 non-refundable application fee for its PhD programmes, which overrides the $85 graduate-school fee.
app_fee.quote: There is a nonrefundable application fee of $90 for the PhD, MS, and Certificate programs.

fee_waiver.value: The school offers a hardship waiver only to US citizens and permanent residents, not to international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: We do offer a hardship application fee waiver for our U.S. citizens/permanent residents, however we do not offer this option for our international applicants.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional for the Basic Science PhD programmes, and not submitting them has no negative effect.
gre_general.quote: GRE is optional. If submitted, scores will be considered. If not submitted, no negative impact on the admissions decision.

english_waiver.value: GSBS accepts degrees from the US, Australia, UK, Ireland, Anglophone Canada or New Zealand, not India, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: Receipt of a 2- or 4-year degree from a college or university in Australia, United Kingdom, Ireland, Anglophone Canada, or New Zealand before the program start date.

also.quote: Receipt of a 2- or 4-year degree from a US-located college or university

toefl_min.value: The Basic Science PhD programmes require TOEFL iBT 100 (or 5 on the new scale); GSBS accepts the current scale through 2027.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL - 100 (current TOEFL iBT score, accepted through end of 2027) or 5 (new TOEFL score)

ielts_min.value: The Basic Science PhD programmes require IELTS Academic 7.0 overall (Duolingo 125 is the alternative).

funding.value: Full-time Basic Science PhD students receive a full tuition scholarship and a stipend or research assistantship, though the page notes some students are self-funded.
funding.quote: Full-time students enrolled in PhD programs in the Basic Science Division receive a full tuition scholarship and a stipend or research assistantship

also.quote: Self-funded students are charged an additional $6,000 per term to defray research laboratory costs.

deadline.value: Basic Science PhD applications close December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027 entry; the GSBS table prints no year.
deadline.quote: Basic Science Division PhD Programs September 15 December 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The official programme page states no rule on needing a supervisor's agreement before admission.

entry_route.value: The official programme page does not say whether a bachelor's or a master's is needed.

notes: One umbrella record for the Basic Science Division: Genetics, Molecular and Cellular Biology; Immunology; Molecular Microbiology; Neuroscience (with Neuro at JAX); Mammalian Genetics at JAX. Neuroscience is listed as a separate PhD degree, so it is covered through also_fields. Clinical & Translational Science and Pharmacology are separate GSBS programmes and are not used. The GSBS English rules (TOEFL 100, IELTS 7.0) are the Basic Science PhD minimums and override the graduate-school view. Supervisor is not stated; students do three lab rotations in the first year.
